literal: Worldly existence fearing, among those who renounced all, killing fearing, non-killing he who cherishes, is foremost.
translation: Among all those who have renounced the world out of fear for the instability of worldly existence, he who cherishes non-killing out of fear for taking life is the foremost.
modern: வாழ்க்கை நிலைக்கு அஞ்சி உலகத்தைத் துறந்தவர்கள் எல்லாரிலும், கொலை செய்ய அஞ்சிக் கொல்லாமையைக் கடைப்பிடிப்பவன் முதன்மையானவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet compares two types of fear and renunciation to establish the supremacy of non-killing. Some people renounce worldly life because they fear its instability and suffering. However, the poet declares that the person who fears the act of killing and actively practices non-killing is the greatest among all ascetics. This emphasizes that compassion towards other living beings is a higher spiritual virtue than merely seeking one's own escape from worldly troubles.
